00070E.d: A longbow used by a warrior burdened with a tragic fate. Its arrows explode upon impact.

t: A bow is held in the left hand. Each normal or heavy attack fires one arrow.
Arrows reach farther than a Rifle's shots and can hit enemies above or below you.
Arrows damage Yowies and Satellite Lizards even from the front, where they block gunfire.
Special attack: Charge Shot II. It fires four piercing arrows, each hit dealing heavy-attack damage. It costs no TP or HP.

ef: Normal and heavy arrows explode with a small Rafoie where they hit, reaching up to 3 targets: the one the arrow struck and up to 2 other enemies in the blast.
The arrow's own hit is a single hit. The blast then deals that hit's full damage to each of the other enemies it reaches.
On a boss, the blast can also strike the boss's other body parts.
The blast of an arrow that misses does no damage.
The blast of a normal or heavy arrow also breaks the boxes inside it.

Charge Shot II's arrows pierce, and each explodes once with a blast as wide as a Lv.30 Rafoie. Up to 4 other targets in the blast each take 50% of that arrow's hit, or 15% if the target is a boss or one of its body parts.
Its arrows deal 20% more damage to machines, on top of the weapon's own Machine percentage.
Catalyst: Constellation. Complete it by defeating 2,000 enemies with the blasts of your normal and heavy arrows.
With the catalyst, normal and heavy attacks fire three homing arrows at full power, seeking bosses and large enemies first. They also break boxes, and they no longer explode.
An enemy hit by these arrows is marked with a light green star for 5 seconds. Up to 4 enemies can carry a star at once.

Everything you deal to a starred enemy is stored in its star. When the star runs out, it erupts into a pillar of light that deals three quarters of the stored damage to that enemy, or to the part of a boss that carries it.
If a starred enemy is defeated early, its star erupts at once where it fell and hits up to 5 enemies around that spot. When it hits 4 or 5, all but the nearest take half.
